name: target
description: The Target Project: define workflows made of sequential steps, each running as a job against one dedicated agent+hook (agent-webhook-bridge) on a shared Claude session.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix hub run typecheck && npm --prefix hub/ui run typecheck
scripts.desktop:install: npm --prefix desktop/linux install && npm --prefix desktop/mac install && npm --prefix desktop/windows install
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run ui:build && npm --prefix desktop/mac run build
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run ui:build && npm --prefix desktop/linux run build
scripts.desktop:build:windows: npm run ui:build && npm --prefix desktop/windows run build
scripts.desktop:build:all: npm run desktop:build:linux && npm run desktop:build:mac && npm run desktop:build:windows
